high_level_description: This image is a promotional post from an Instagram account celebrating the achievement of a movie reaching 100 crores (1 billion) worldwide. The post includes a poster for the movie "Hanuman," which is prominently displayed. Poster Content: The poster features two characters: one larger figure, presumably Lord Hanuman, standing on a rock with his right arm raised in a triumphant gesture.
